METAKI
Dresden, Germany (TU Dresden) | On-site / Hybrid | Co-Founder / Equity | Deep Tech / AI for Engineering

About Metaki
Metaki is building a 'Large Engineering Model' (LEM): a graph-neural-network surrogate trained on large-scale finite element simulation (FEA) data that predicts, near-instantly, how complex 3D parts respond to different materials, loads and boundary conditions — replacing slow FEA runs. The initial focus is solid and structural mechanics, with the long-term ambition of a general foundation model for engineering physics.

The opportunity
Founded by Samir El Masri (Founder, ongoing PhD in FEM, 3 years of industry experience in FEM & AI/ML for engineering), Metaki already has a working FEM → data → NN pipeline, is building out a large 3D training dataset, and is running training alongside early industry discussions. What's missing is a technical co-founder to help scale the modeling and engineering work while Samir also drives funding applications and industrial pilot partnerships.

Pixi, rattler and rattler-build are open source and used by hundreds of thousands of developers: quant teams in finance, physicists at CERN, biotech labs, and humanoid robot companies you've probably seen videos of. Bouw mee aan onze warmtepompen

Bij DeWarmte maken we slimme en betaalbare warmtepompen waarmee we woningen van het gas af helpen. En die warmtepompen maken we zelf.

In ons magazijn in Utrecht komen alle onderdelen binnen en worden onze warmtepompen in elkaar gezet en getest. Daar kunnen we extra handen goed gebruiken.

Daarom zoeken we een Assemblage- en magazijnmedewerker.

Wat jij hier doet

Je werkt afwisselend in het magazijn en aan de assemblage van onze warmtepompen.

  • Je zorgt dat onderdelen op de juiste plek liggen

jobs.title: Service Monteur Warmtepompen
jobs.description:
De meeste monteurs in Nederland vervangen vandaag nog steeds ketels die er over tien jaar niet meer staan.

Ben je loodgieter, servicemonteur of cv-monteur? Bij ons stap je over op de techniek die daarvoor in de plaats komt. Ervaring met warmtepompen hoeft niet, die leren we je. Wat je wel meeneemt is je gevoel voor leidingwerk. Geen storingsdienst, een volledig uitgeruste bus, en je werkdag begint als je instapt.

WIJ MAKEN WARMTE ZONDER GAS

Wist je dat wij onze warmtepompen zelf ontwerpen? Met een club van rond de zestig mensen bedenken we ze, assembleren we ze in Utrecht en installeren we ze zelf. Voor huiseigenaren door heel Nederland en sinds dit jaar ook in Duitsland. Vorig jaar won onze Pomp MP als eerste warmtepomp ooit zowel de iF Design Award Gold als de Red Dot.

Elke week gaan er tientallen huizen van het gas af. Het doel is 10% van alle Nederlandse woningen, ongeveer 800.000 huizen. De vraag is er en het product staat. De rem zit op hoe snel we kunnen leveren.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Staff Software Engineer, Platform & Infrastructure

The role

We are hiring a Staff Software Engineer for our Infrastructure team.

Stream runs behind apps that more than a billion people use: billions of API requests a month, a 99.999% uptime promise, and a small team keeping it all running. Infrastructure here decides how fast our products feel, how well they scale, and how quickly we can launch new ones.

This year we're wrapping up a big move. We're simplifying where and how we host, and rebuilding our data layer on self-hosted, open-source systems that are faster and cheaper to run. That's the groundwork, not the job. Next comes building the infrastructure every Stream product runs on, including the ones we haven't built yet. That means real SLOs, clear costs, calmer on-call, and a platform that helps teams ship faster.

What you build will shape how much Stream spends and how fast it grows, and we'll trust you with big decisions from your first few weeks.

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. Traditional industrial manufacturing systems were built for predictability. Supply chains no longer are. Today, real-time data is buried in legacy tools that weren't designed for constant disruption. By the time an issue surfaces, it has already snowballed, sending everyone into firefighting mode. Pelico exists to close the gap between production plans and the daily reality on the factory floor.
